expect.title: Things Not Mentioned in the Includes
expect.body: Must be paid by customers, e.g. Marine park, other activities etc.

expect.title: Prepare Cash
expect.body: For Marine Park and shopping around Perhentian Island. Cards and QR are not available at some shops.

expect.title: Shared Boat Transfer
expect.body: Please be on time as per itinerary and as updated by our team for all boat timing.

expect.title: Room Arrangement
expect.body: Triple sharing room with 3 single beds will be provided based on availability. Extra bed will be added if no triple bed is available on travel period.

expect.title: Meals
expect.body: Meals provided during the trip (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner) will be local food.

expect.title: Monsoon Season
expect.body: Perhentian is closed during Monsoon season from 15 October - 15 February. No trip available on this date.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2@3 person per room (Additional RM600/person for Single Supplement).
The price stated is Default Standard Room.
Price is not applicable during peak seasons; please refer to the peak season surcharge.
Late Booking Surcharge of RM50/booking will apply for bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date.
All Itinerary, flight, price or quotation is subject to changes.
Itinerary during trip is subject to changes (due to weather, traffic, safety & etc).
Final Itinerary and accommodation arrangements will be shared 14 days before trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity or before booking any connecting flights.
Any free activities is non exchangeable with other activities, voucher or cash if the client is not joining or due to availability & weather condition.
Boat timing is subject to weather and sea tide conditions.
SIC Tour = Boat and activity sharing with other tourist.
Shared Boat Transfer = Boat transfer sharing with other tourist.

deposit.text: prior to departure for full payment
